      public TalonFXConfig withTorqueCurrentLimits(double peakForwardTorqueCurrentAmps, double peakReverseTorqueCurrentAmps, double neutralToleranceAmps)
      Modifies this configuration's torque current limits. Limits apply during torque current control modes.
      Parameters:
      peakForwardTorqueCurrentAmps - Maximum forward torque current output in amperes.
      peakReverseTorqueCurrentAmps - Maximum reverse torque current output in amperes.
      neutralToleranceAmps - Current range in amperes where requested torque current will result in zero bridge output.

      Itself for easier method-chaining.

      public TalonFXConfig withSoftLimits(boolean forwardEnable, boolean reverseEnable, double forwardThresholdRotations, double reverseThresholdRotations)
